m: शाठायन्य m. patr. fr. शठ (pl. ˚यनाः), g. कुञ्जादि.
शाठ m. (prob. patr. fr. शठ) See कठ-श्˚.
शाठ्यायनीय m. pl. N. of a Śākhā or school, MW. (prob. w.r. for शाट्य्˚).

s: klI, (SaWasya BAvaH । SaWa + zyaY .) SaWatA । (yaTA । “SaWe SAWyaM samAcaret ॥”) tatparyyAyaH । kapawaH 2 vyAjaH 3 damBaH 4 upaDiH 5 Cadma 6 kEtavam 7 kusftiH 8 nikftiH 9 । ityamaraH ॥ nava ayaTArTavyavahAre । SaWa vaDe kleSakEtave tAlavyAdiH al tasya karmma SAWyaM zRyaH । kapawAdizawkaM Cadmani kusftyAditrayaM cittakOwilye ityeke । kapawAdizawkaM vaYcanamAtraPalam । kusftyAditrikantu hiMsAPalamiti BedaH । iti sarvvAnando maDuSca । navEvEkArTA iti vahavaH । iti BarataH ॥ api ca । “astriyAM kapawo vyAja upaDirdamBa eva ca । kUwaM kalkaM CalaM Cadma mizakEravakEtavam ॥ aTa SAWyaYca SaWatA kusftirnikftiSca sA । hiMsAPale catuzkaM syAt SAWyaparyyAya IritaH ॥ pUrvvaH kapawaparyyAyaH Pale vaYcanamAtrake । uBayorekaparyyAya iti kecit pracakzate ॥” iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
m: शाठ्य n. wickedness, deceit, guile, roguery, dishonesty, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: शाठ्यं — [शठस्य भावः ष्यञ्] (a) Dishonesty, perfidy, guile, trickery, fraud, villainy; आजन्मनः शाठ्यमशिक्षितो यः Ś. 5. 25; (b) Art, skill, cunning; देव्या निह्नोतुमिच्छोरिति सुरसरितं शाठ्यमव्याद्विभोर्वः Mu. 1. 1.

m: शाठ्य—वत् mfn. deceitful, wicked, dishonest, VarBṛS.
